name: Volunteers of America of Massachusetts, Inc.: veteran housing help (SSVF)
organization: Volunteers of America of Massachusetts, Inc.
description: VA-funded Supportive Services for Veteran Families (SSVF, grant 12-MA-040): case management, help keeping a home, rapid rehousing and short-term financial help for low-income veteran households.
